title: Missing context is fixed before model escalation
invariant: A failure caused by missing task context must be repaired as context/decomposition rather than bought away with a stronger model.
given: A bounded Implementer running Sonnet/medium fails because the Task Packet referenced a component but omitted the required interface file and the worker could not infer the contract. Failure evidence clearly identifies the missing interface context. There is no evidence of a capability gap.
when: The PM chooses the next attempt.

must: repair the Task Packet or provide/reference the missing context
retry only after the context defect is corrected
must_not: escalate to Opus merely because the first attempt failed
increase effort instead of fixing the known missing context
